rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides secure file system exploration and project analysis for TypeScript/JavaScript codebases, built by Noah Jansky using TypeScript and the MCP SDK. It offers six core tools: project exploration with automatic import/export analysis for code files, advanced file search with regex support and content filtering, file management operations (rename/move and delete with safety checks), package dependency analysis using npm outdated, and directory access control through configurable allowed paths. The implementation features intelligent exclusion of build directories (node_modules, .git, dist), language-aware comment and string literal filtering for cleaner code searches, comprehensive file metadata including size formatting and modification dates, and security validation ensuring all operations stay within permitted directories, making it valuable for AI assistants that need safe, controlled access to analyze codebases, search for patterns across projects, and perform basic file management tasks.
